provenance.analogue: size procedure, E9.0 cut-off lifted, all three rules averaged

departures.a: the E9.0 rate cut-off is lifted (min_start_t = -inf): every practice rate interval starts before E9.0, so the pre-registered settings give valid=False and no figure (row H25)
departures.b: rule selection is forced to all three pre-registered rules (tie_tol = inf), the test's outcome, reached at the test by no eligible pseudo-target
departures.c: copy_last on E8.25_late -> E8.5, the one transition with one input stage
departures.d: an in-memory size result applied through apply_size_procedure; size_or_hold's crosscheck (hardwired to E10.5) is redone by guard V7 on each transition's untrimmed reference stage
departures.e: the practice board's count rule sets the cell number, not the test board's
departures.f: the preregistered field holds the raw result; the builder passes --z-mode raw, so the recorded mode never enters
